_comment: SHA256 digests of the archgate BINARIES that the ADR gate is allowed to execute.
The gate copies the binary it finds, verifies the copy against the digest
pinned here, and runs the verified copy. A version string is not a pin: a
replaced binary prints whatever version it likes. The runners are
persistent and shared by every repository in the organisation and their
$HOME (and therefore ~/.archgate/bin) is writable by every job that runs
on them, so the bytes have to be checked, not the version.
platform key = <uname -s lowercased>-<arch>, where x86_64/amd64 becomes
When a digest has to change, the change is expected to be visible: the gate
fails closed and prints the expected and the actual digest.

linux-arm64.source: built from source on the runner host (bun --compile); upstream publishes no linux/arm64 release asset
